note: Nubank's own blog (updated 28 July 2026): the Nubank account charges no maintenance fee or other hidden fees, only the taxes on its yield (income tax and IOF).

sources.title: Nubank, A conta do Nubank vale a pena? (atualizado em 28 Jul 2026)
